notes.title: Play ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS at Indie Game Utsav – April 12–13, Mumbai!
notes.notes:
Prepare to enter the arena! ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS, our team-based strategy game inspired by ancient Indian legends, will be playable live at Indie Game Utsav on April 12th & 13th at the Jio World Convention Center, Mumbai.

You’ll also get the chance to meet and catch up with the dev team behind ILAVATH, share your thoughts, and get a sneak peek into what’s coming next!

notes.title: We are Coming to GDC 2025 – India Pavilion Showcase!
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to announce that ILAVATH Battle Arenas will be showcased at GDC 2025 as part of the India Pavilion! This is a huge moment for us, and we can’t wait to bring our intense battle arenas to one of the biggest gaming events in the world.

If you're attending GDC 2025 in San Francisco, stop by the India Pavilion to get hands-on with our latest demo, meet the developers, and dive into the action-packed gameplay of ILAVATH Battle Arenas.

Stay tuned for more updates, behind-the-scenes content, and showcase details. See you at GDC 2025! 🚀🎮🔥

notes.title: Discover ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS at IGDC 2024
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS will be at the India Game Developer Conference in Hyderabad, November 13-15, 2024! You can find us at Booths E2 and E3, where we’re debuting the first multiplayer version of the game!

This is your chance to dive into ILAVATH’s immersive world of ancient legends, unique races, and epic battles – all with multiplayer action. Meet the developers, get insights into the making of the game, and be among the first to experience multiplayer gameplay. Stop by for exclusive giveaways, surprises, and more!

See you there!

Team 5th Ocean Studios

notes.title: ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS Wins Rising Star of the Year at Game On! 2024 🌟
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS has been awarded the Rising Star of the Year at Game On 2024 in Hong Kong! Founder Yasaswy Sarma Veluri had the honor of introducing ILAVATH to an enthusiastic audience. He also joined a special Founders Mode chat with industry leaders, including Sebastien Borget, COO of The Sandbox, and Bowie Lau, Founder of Mage Hold Investments.

notes.title: Explore ILAVATH & Exclusive Merch at Hyderabad Comic Con & DreamHack
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that ILAVATH: BATTLE ARENAS will be at Hyderabad Comic Con & DreamHack, from November 15-17, 2024, at HITEX, Hall 3!

Visit us at Hall 3 ILAVATH’s first multiplayer version. Immerse yourself in a world of ancient legends, diverse races, and epic arena battles, all with multiplayer gameplay. Meet the developers, gain insights into the making of the game, and be among the first to experience our exclusive content!

Plus, for the first time, we’re offering ILAVATH merchandise on sale—grab T-shirts, hoodies, stickers, action figures, and more! Don’t miss out on giveaways, surprises, and everything ILAVATH.

See you there!

Team 5th Ocean Studios
